purpose: Classifies input text into candidate category labels based on rule/keyword matching heuristics.
capability: Scores text against candidate label keyword sets and returns top label.

input.categories: dict of label -> list of keywords/phrases

interface: index.py -> classify_text_label(text: str, categories: dict, default_label: str = 'unknown') -> dict
failure_behavior: Returns default_label if no keywords match.
